description: A PNG of the model, iso (3D) or plan (rooms named and measured), written to disk and shown. For a building with several storeys pass `storey` with a plan, or every storey is drawn over the others. Free; up to a minute when the model is not loaded.

output_path.description: A file or folder to write to. Default ./aibimtool-output/.

project_id.description: The project's id, as create_building or list_projects returned it.

storey.description: With view plan: the storey's name ("Level 2") or its number from the ground floor (0).

name: get_model_image
title: Look at the model
